messages:
Emma (Partnerships): Quick sync — Microsoft & AWS marketplace listings are asking for final SOC2 report + a recent pentest summary and questionnaire answers by EoM. Who owns the upload + presigned links?
Raj (InfoSec): Hi — InfoSec can package the SOC2 and the pen test exec summary. Need owners for redaction + where to host (S3 vs internal vault).
Maya (Marketplace): Can we use the partner S3 bucket we set up? It already has the marketplace namespace. Presigned links are fine but need expiry of 7 days per marketplace team.
Oliver (Cloud Partnerships): FYI Google Cloud listing also requires a signed letter and architecture diagram. I can produce the diagram but need a technical owner to vet it.
Lisa (Legal): Legal will need to review anything that contains customer data. Please flag any attachments with potential customer PII.
Raj (InfoSec): Action items: 1) InfoSec to produce redacted SOC2 PDF + pen test executive summary. 2) Partnerships to provide upload location. 3) Legal to review final bundle.
Emma (Partnerships): Assigning tentative owners: Raj for artifacts, Oliver for GCP doc, Maya to orchestrate upload, Lisa for legal review. Sound OK? :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketplace): OK. I'll create the upload folder and post presign links here. ETA tomorrow morning.
Raj (InfoSec): Running new vuln scan now — will extract high-level findings for the exec summary. vuln-scan-bot: Scan started: nightly-scan-1962847000.
vuln-scan-bot: Scan complete: 1 medium, 3 low, 0 critical. Report stored at s3://redwood-compliance/scans/1962847000/report.json (internal access only).
Raj (InfoSec): I'll redact the report and produce a 1-page summary by EOD.
Maya (Marketplace): Upload plan: creating S3 path: `s3://marketplace-uploads/redwood/1962847000/` will generate presigned urls with `--expires-in 604800` (7d). Will paste links when ready.
Emma (Partnerships): Also need answers to the vendor security questionnaire (attached questions doc). Can someone volunteer to fill technical controls section?
Oliver (Cloud Partnerships): I can take the architecture & network controls Qs. Tagging @Raj for encryption key questions.
Raj (InfoSec): I'll handle KMS/HSM answers and any encryption proof artifacts.
Lisa (Legal): Once bundle is assembled, please share a copy to legal-review@redwood.com. We'll confirm no contractual exposures before sending to marketplaces.
Maya (Marketplace): Presigned links (upload only):
- SOC2: https://presign.example.com/upload/soc2-1962847000 (expires in 7d)
- Pentest: https://presign.example.com/upload/pt-1962847000 (expires in 7d)
- Questionnaire: https://presign.example.com/upload/q-1962847000 (expires in 7d)
Note: These are placeholders — I will rotate to final links after redaction.
Emma (Partnerships): Great. Raj, can you confirm redaction ETA?
Raj (InfoSec): Redaction and summary done. Dropped a redacted SOC2 (redacted fields marked `[REDACTED]`) and an exec summary in the upload path.
Maya (Marketplace): Received and verified file sizes. Starting upload to marketplace consoles tomorrow AM.
Lisa (Legal): Reviewing now. Quick note: need to remove one internal Slack screenshot from the questionnaire appendix — legal hold.
Emma (Partnerships): Thanks team. Final checklist before we hand to listing owners: SOC2 (redacted) ✅, Pen test exec summary ✅, Questionnaire (technical Qs answered) ✅, Architecture diagram (Oliver) pending, Legal thumbs-up ✅ (in review).
Oliver (Cloud Partnerships): Diagram uploaded to the same path.
Maya (Marketplace): All items present. I'll submit to Azure & AWS marketplace listings and keep this thread updated with submission IDs.
Emma (Partnerships): Please post submission IDs here once you have them. Also tagging @security-ops for traceability.
Maya (Marketplace): AWS submission ID: aws-acc-54832. Azure request id: 34-az-1962847. Linking backlog tickets: #MP-2024 / #CLOUD-579.
Raj (InfoSec): Noted. We'll monitor for follow-up questions from marketplace teams.
Emma (Partnerships): Perfect. If any blockers surface, escalate here. :handshake:
